newsitem.title: UK: Royal & Sun in EBRD deal for eastern Europe.
newsitem.headline: Royal & Sun in EBRD deal for eastern Europe.

text.p: Britain's Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc said on Wednesday it agreed to a deal with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) to develop business opportunities in central and eastern Europe.
Under the terms of a three year partnership signed between Royal Sun and the EBRD, the latter will invest up to 25.3 million stg in any projects the company develops in central and eastern Europe.
Royal Sun said it would also benefit from the EBRD's political and commercial connections in identifying opportunities in the region.
The company's deputy chairman Roger Taylor said he believed there were significant business opportunities in central and eastern Europe which offered sustainable growth and future profit.
